test_title: PYST 28: SSC JE ME - Reasoning (Held on: 22 March 2021 (Evening)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the dice (from among the figures A, B, C and D) that can be formed by folding the given sheet along the lines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34211dea7cbd44149c56fa996cbe0453f361b003cde517b0c3ad021a44952976.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11d6956f6037e4e14a94eaba31bf77d98e52bc7659c90cf4335453256c107c47.png]
solution:
When the unfolded dice is folded, the faces opposite to each other is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ea027b34eed9275c18cc9ca62325cce91525882e5ea8ed3ab09c90fd96a171d.png] 

The Opposite of 2 is 3.

The Opposite of 6 is 4.

The Opposite of 1 is 5.

The dice A and D cannot be formed when the given sheet is folded because the opposite faces appear together in these dice.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only B and C**".
